text_block_list.text:
One day, Verxina was carefully checking 
her racing silks in a full-length mirror—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No problems with the skirt pleats. The 
silhouette line is just as requested too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an established, historic 
brand. The quality of their maintenance is 
always reliable.

Verxina sends her racing attire for 
maintenance at frequent intervals. Each 
time, it's her habit to inspect the finish 
with meticulous precision.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
All that's left... is adjusting the 
position of the pinned cloak, and it'll be 
perfect.
choice_data_list:
Oh, is that just temporarily held in 
place?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. How it flutters in the wind. And how 
much of the outfit it covers when it hangs 
down.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because I'll have to look back at it time 
and time again.
choice_data_list: You're really particular about that, huh.

You're really particular about that, 
aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes... It happened on a family trip, when 
I saw the tropical ocean—

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Hey, look, look! Best friend fishies! The 
right one is me, and the left one is 
Cheval-chi!

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that's true. ...Wait, huh? What 
about me?

text_block_list.name: Young Cheval
text_block_list.text:
—...The sea. I think Big Sis... is like 
the sea...

text_block_list.name: Young Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Yup!! It's so gentle and swaying! 
Sparkling and pretty, and it makes us 
sparkle too!

text_block_list.name: Young Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Really? Ehehe. Then I'll just have to stay 
sparkling and pretty forever!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...This cape is made in the image of the 
gentle waves I saw back then."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
So that this "sea" may always belong to 
the two of us.
choice_data_list: Yeah, you're shining brightly to me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. However, it is not 
yet complete.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Because racewear is meant to shine on the 
turf.

A tension uncharacteristic of a mere 
racewear fitting hung in the air. I 
wondered if the final result would be 
satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Cheval, Vivlos... I swear it.)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Like the sea I saw that day! Like the 
waves translucent with light!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: "I will shine!! Haaaaaaah!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Phew... That was a great finish. Now I can 
enter the race without any worries.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I couldn't help but be captivated.
Yeah, I couldn't take my eyes off it.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: It would hardly do otherwise. Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiiiiis♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... Vivlos. Over there, she's—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
That was an amazing run~~! You were 
shining so brightly~~!!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Cheva-chi, come on out~! I know 
you're right there!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Big sis really is...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Cheva-chi says, "Big Sis, you're as 
pretty as the ocean!" I think so too~~!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! V-Vivlos!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Those girls... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will always be a big sister you can be 
proud of. Keep watching over me, both of 
you."
choice_data_list:
Looks like your feelings reached both of 
them too.

Looks like your feelings reached both of 
them too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"I will always be a big sister you can be 
proud of. Keep watching over me, both of 
you."
choice_data_list:
Looks like your feelings reached both of 
them too.

Looks like your feelings reached both of 
them too.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"...Truth be told, I have never directly 
explained the intent behind my racing 
attire's design, but..."

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Even so—I wonder if they received my 
feelings.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...I'm off! To where those girls are!

With a bright smile on her face, Verxina 
headed over to her sisters!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes, indeed. Shall we get changed soon—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Big siiiiis! Again, one more time~~♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Oh, that Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, just one more lap. Is that 
alright with you, Trainer?

Once again, Verxina showed her dazzling 
self to her younger sisters!
